options.detail: Choose changes between HEAD and the working tree. Patch mode keeps staged changes by default and takes precedence over --staged. Incompatible with -u and -a. --no-patch cancels interactive selection. Put -- before paths on Ubuntu 24.04. Ubuntu 26.04 also accepts paths directly after the patch flag.

options.summary: Stash only staged changes
options.detail: Leave unstaged changes in the working tree. This can fail if unstaged edits overlap the staged changes. Incompatible with -u and -a. --no-staged cancels staged-only selection.

options.detail: The stash still records the index. With an ordinary push, staged changes stay in the index and working tree after the stash is made.

options.detail: Use - for standard input. Separate pathspecs with LF or CRLF, or use --pathspec-file-nul for NUL separators. Use the file instead of command-line pathspecs. Incompatible with --patch and --staged. --no-pathspec-from-file clears an earlier file selection.

options.summary: Read NUL-separated pathspecs
options.detail: Requires --pathspec-from-file. Newlines and quotes are ordinary characters within each element. Git still applies pathspec matching rules. --no-pathspec-file-nul restores newline delimiters.

options.summary: Show the command usage
options.detail: --help-all also prints built-in usage. Immediately after stash, --help opens the Git manual viewer.

options.summary: Leave untracked and ignored files in place
options.detail: Cancels an earlier -u or -a. The parser also accepts --no-all for this reset.

options.summary: Set context around each selectable hunk
options.detail: Requires --patch and one integer, for example -U1 or --unified=1. With zero context, Git 2.53 can display a hunk and then fail to stash it. Ubuntu 24.04 lacks this option.

options.summary: Set context around each selectable hunk
options.detail: Requires --patch and one integer, for example -U1 or --unified=1. With zero context, Git 2.53 can display a hunk and then fail to stash it. Ubuntu 24.04 lacks this option.

options.summary: Join nearby changes into a single selectable hunk
options.detail: Use --patch and a line count to select nearby changes together. Ubuntu 24.04 lacks this option.

options.summary: Advance after deciding every hunk in a file
options.detail: The default in upstream Git 2.56 patch mode. Both Ubuntu clients reject this switch.

options.summary: Allow revisiting a file during hunk selection
options.detail: Use with --patch in upstream Git 2.56. Move between files before finalizing the selection. Both Ubuntu clients reject this switch.

options.summary: Save and roll back local changes
options.detail: With no keyword, git stash also pushes. Use -- before pathspecs for portable implicit push. Unselected paths keep their changes.

options.summary: Restore a stash and retain its entry
options.detail: Defaults to the newest stash. Apply also accepts a stash-shaped commit that has no stash-list entry.

options.summary: Restore a stash and drop it on success
options.detail: Defaults to the newest entry. A conflicting pop keeps the entry for conflict resolution and a later manual drop.

options.summary: List saved entries from the stash reflog
options.detail: The newest entry is stash@{0}. Log formatting and filtering options follow list.

options.summary: Compare a saved working tree with its original base
options.detail: Supply a stash selector or use the newest entry. Diff options follow show.

options.summary: Restore a stash on a new branch at its original base
options.detail: Supply BRANCH and optionally STASH. Git checks out the new branch and restores the index and files. Success drops a selected stash-list entry.

options.summary: Remove all entries from the stash list
options.detail: The saved objects become eligible for pruning and can become impossible to recover.

options.summary: Remove one entry from the stash list
options.detail: Supply STASH or omit it for the latest entry. Use -q or --quiet after drop to suppress normal output.

options.summary: Create a stash object and print its ID
options.detail: Accepts an optional message. Leaves the working tree and stash list in place. Use store to retain the resulting commit.

options.summary: Add a stash-shaped commit to the stash list
options.detail: Supply the commit made by create. Use -m or --message for the reflog message and -q or --quiet to suppress normal output.

options.summary: Save changes using the deprecated message syntax
options.detail: Remaining words form the message. For a path-limited stash, use push. Save supports the push selection flags except the pathspec options.

options.summary: Build a transferable commit chain of stashes
options.detail: Git 2.53 and current upstream support export. Choose --print for the chain tip or --to-ref REF to retain it locally. Supply stash selectors or omit them for all entries. Ubuntu 24.04 lacks export.

options.summary: Append stashes from an exported commit chain
options.detail: Supply the tip commit produced by export. Existing entries stay on the list. Git 2.53 and current upstream support import. Ubuntu 24.04 lacks it.
